name: Shubham Kaushik
career_history: Associate Director at Turner & Townsend, 3/2026 to present; Senior Consultant at Turner & Townsend, 2/2024 to 3/2026; Senior Cost Manager at AtkinsRéalis, 5/2022 to 2/2024; Cost Manager at AtkinsRéalis, 10/2021 to 4/2022; Quantity Surveyor at AtkinsRéalis, 9/2018 to 9/2021; Construction Cost Analyst at AtkinsRéalis, 6/2017 to 8/2018
notes: Works at an adjacent-industry company (GC / energy / civil / industrial); re-imported 2026-09-09 at Siddhi's request.

Bachelor of Engineering - BE, Civil Engineering, Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, 2011 to 2015
biography: Shubham is a young and enthusiastic Built environment professional with keen interest in commercial management. In 2017, he started his career with Faithful+Gould, a world leading Project and programme management consultancy; working on developing the group's business intelligence capabilities and pioneering use of ICMS for built asset benchmarking. In 2018, he moved to UAE and worked with Faithful+Gould's award winning commercial services team, which has won several accolades at ME consultant awards each year, on a Pre Contracts role. In 2019, Shubham started his APC journey to become chartered with RICS and began secondment on a major portfolio of several planned/developing assets including Leisure, Residential, Retail, F&B and major Infrastructure from Pre Contract Budgeting, Tendering, Procurement through to facilitating Contracts, and establishing Post Contract cost control procedures for a major master developer in Abu Dhabi. In 2020, while continuing his engagement at the capital project PMO, he mentored two university students to break into the industry. In 2021, Shubham moved into a fast track post contract, Contract Administration role for delivery of a number of community facilities in the city of Abu Dhabi. He also continued the mentorship role with RICS SBE and mentored two university students who will be graduating in 2022. By Q4 2021, he made the move to Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia on a PMO based post contract Client's PQS role. What does he do everyday? Either helping define the problem, or finding solutions.
